svg.title: BrewLite domain class diagram - SCRUM-105
svg.desc: UML classes, typed attributes and relationship multiplicities. See README.md for source mapping and limitations.
svg.text: BrewLite | SCRUM-105 / A2-T2.3 | A1-final | DRAFT - pending review
UML: filled diamond = composition; dashed /association and /attribute = derived, not persisted separately.
MoneyVnd = non-negative integer VND. Multiplicities describe all history; guards limit active orders and accepted payments.
VNPay retry: Order remains PAYMENT_FAILED while the new Payment attempt is PENDING; no extra resource reservation.
